snippet.title: Anomalistic Revolution | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Anomalistic Revolution is an anime styled indie RPG where you play a software developer by day and battle nightmare creatures by night.

Wishlist us on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168120/Anomalistic_Revolution/
